prompt: Draft an email apologizing for sending an outdated event flyer. Clearly state that the correct start time is 3 p.m., and that the location has not changed. Please answer in roughly 160 words.
text:
Subject: Correction: Event Start Time Is 3 p.m.

Hi everyone,

I’m writing to apologize for sending an outdated version of the event flyer in my earlier email. I’m sorry for any confusion this may have caused, especially if you’ve already used that information to plan your day or shared it with others.

Please note that the correct start time is **3 p.m.** The location has not changed, so please come to the same venue listed on the flyer. The time shown on the outdated flyer should be disregarded.

If you forwarded my earlier email or passed along the flyer, I would appreciate it if you could share this correction with those recipients as well. That will help ensure everyone has the right information before the event.

Thank you for your understanding, and again, I apologize for the mix-up. We look forward to seeing you at 3 p.m. at the originally announced location.

Best,  
[Your Name]
